block.title: the pure expanding ring
block.positive: A pinpoint of white light at frame center blooms into a perfectly round expanding shockwave ring racing outward across a deep navy pixel-art starfield, the ring's edge bright white with a thin violet inner glow, star pixels and loose debris ahead of it pushed aside and scattering as it passes, the whole frame washing to soft white at the end, camera static, one single accelerating expansion, no cuts.

block.notes: Geometrically simple motion — LTX almost never fumbles a single expanding circle. The wash-to-white final frame is the universal transition card: reuse it as the outgoing cut between every major beat in trailers.
